## Upgrading from a version with flat commands

Commands are grouped by level: `forgecycle task …` acts on one task run,
`forgecycle roadmap …` on a roadmap, and project commands such as `init` and
`doctor` stay at the top level. The old names (`forgecycle run`, `resume`,
`approve`, `reject`, `fallback`, `abandon`, `clean`, `decompose`) are unknown
commands now. ForgeCycle does not read or resume runs made by earlier
versions: finish or abandon them before upgrading, then delete the old
`.forgecycle/runs/` directory by hand. Their branches stay in Git. Run
`forgecycle doctor` afterwards; it warns about runtime paths missing from
`.gitignore`, such as the new `.forgecycle/task-runs/` and
`.forgecycle/roadmap-runs/`.

## Upgrading from Foreman and Builder

Foreman is split into Decomposer, Planner, and Reviewer. The old
names are rejected, with no aliases:

| Before | Now |
| --- | --- |
| policy lists `decompose`, `planning`, `building`, `reviewing` | `decomposer`, `planner`, `builder`, `reviewer` |
| `--foreman ID` | `--planner ID` and `--reviewer ID` |
| `--candidate ID`, `task fallback` | `--builder ID` or the role flag the stop block names |
| checkpoints `after_plan`, `after_builder`, `after_review` | `after_planning`, `after_building`, `after_reviewing` |
| handoffs `NNN-foreman-plan.md`, `NNN-foreman-review.md` | `NNN-planner-plan.md`, `NNN-reviewer-review.md` |
| stop kind `foreman_mutation` | `read_only_mutation` |

Rename the keys in `.forgecycle/config.json` and in task front matter, then
run `forgecycle doctor`. Task runs and roadmap runs started by an earlier
version cannot be resumed: finish or abandon them before upgrading.
